coverageContext: Han Chinese TPMI research model for a broad coded pneumonia endpoint, including several infectious causes and history codes; not a pathogen-specific susceptibility score. Evaluation736cases/18,137controls reported AUROC0.612 with age, sex, array and ancestry covariates, not GA genetics alone. EUR ranks are withheld. Does not detect current infection, measure exposure or immunity, predict severity, select vaccination, or guide antibiotics.

Han Chinese TPMI research model for coded chronic hepatitis, evaluated in1,720cases/14,911controls with age, sex, array and ancestry covariates. Catalog development and evaluation code lists differ and include toxic, autoimmune and unspecified inflammatory liver disease; this is not a hepatitis B/C infection score or a single-cause diagnosis. EUR ranks are withheld. No current liver-function, viral-status, fibrosis-stage or treatment inference is made.
